blocks.text: The following HTTP status codes are returned by OneAPI. In addition, the APIs for specific Zscaler services might use a set of status codes that is exclusive to that service. The following sections provide information on the status codes that are exclusive to specific services.

table: The authorization token is invalid, expired, or missing.
The API client does not have access to the requested resource.
The requested API resource could not be found.
The client took too long to send a complete request.
The HTTP request exceeds the maximum allowable size.
The API client exceeded the rate limit or quota. Too many requests have been made in a short period.
An internal server error occurred while processing the request.
The requested resource is temporarily unavailable.
The server took too long to respond to the request.
